title: Snapshot
description: The Snapshot report compares an average day for a year against weekday and monthly averages as well as against AM or PM peak and Off-peak. The report looks at average speeds and congestion.
_note: Reconstructed via --from-page 2210358, cross-referenced against the snap row's route_comps->graphIds (this page predates _measurePick, same as Bi-directional — --from-page could only recover graphType). Only 4 legacy comps survive live (comp-0/'2023'+comp-8/'All-time Average' sharing group 163185; comp-16/comp-17, two separate '2023' groups 6476/6475 that turned out to be a duplicate/redundant slot split, not a real 2nd dimension — no directionality or 2nd-corridor concept is in this report's own description). Per apply_today_relative_patches.py's own REPORTS[2210358] patch (comp-0/16/17 all collapsed to ONE 'Current Year' name+formula, comp-8 to 'Trailing 3 Years' -- 'All-time Average' folded into Trailing 3 Years per Ryan's own prior direction, 'the split data gotcha' -- 'Ryan's "3 years for all of these"'), simplified down to exactly 2 real routes sharing one slot group: Current Year (yearof) and Trailing 3 Years (year-2year->3year). Reconstructed 3 completely orphaned graphs (Monthly, Weekday x2 -- 'Daily Average Speed By Month', 'Average Speed by Day of Week', 'Total Hours of Delay by Day of Week' referenced ZERO live routes, their dedicated sub-routes long gone) using graph-level resolution (month/weekday) on Current Year -- no dead routes needed, same pattern as This Month vs. Last Month vs. Last Year and Seasonality. Merged 2 redundant single-comp Maps (g1 fed only by the now-dropped 6476 slot, g11 already covering everything) into one Map fed by both real routes. Dropped 2 graphs needing AM/PM/Off-Peak sub-routes ('Average Speed by Peak', 'Average Avg. Hours of Delay by Peak') -- this is the SAME still-unverified startTime/endTime+dateFormula gap flagged on Monthly Speed Comparisons (report_build.mjs's own validation at line ~649 hard-requires a literal startDate/endDate whenever startTime/endTime are set, which a dateFormula-driven slot route never has at spec-write time -- confirmed genuinely blocking, not just unverified, by reading the validation code directly). Now 2 templates need it -- worth building for real once the sweep is done, not hypothetical anymore.
